correctness.rationale: For n>=3, each voter approves adjacent candidates and F(W)=2k-A(W)/2, with A the number of adjacent selected pairs. The optimum has A*=max(0,2k-n) and is realizable. Marginal 2-d_W(i)/2 forces greedy to a maximal independent set M of size m between ceil(n/3) and floor(n/2); all such m occur as cycle gap patterns of lengths one/two. Subsequently n-2m selected steps have one new adjacency and m have two, yielding A_g-A*=max(0,min(k,n-k)-m) and full half-step loss spectrum. Ratio F_g/F*>=11/12, equality precisely n multiple six and k=n/2. Independent full-tie direct voter enumeration corroborates n=3..11 but the all-n proof is the gap argument.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration only; the analytic proof supplies the quantified claim.
